metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: This cerebral, beautifully shot sci-fi masterpiece matches your appreciation for intelligent, high-stakes science fiction like Ex Machina and The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: Prisoners
metas.description: A deeply intense, emotionally grueling thriller with incredible performances that aligns perfectly with your taste for dark mysteries like Gone Girl and Sicario.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description: David Fincher's meticulously detailed psychological thriller demands absolute attention and mirrors the gritty, procedural intensity of Sicario.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: A psychological mystery with a thick gothic atmosphere, matching the dread of The Others and the twisty, cerebral pacing of Gone Girl.

metas.name: Hereditary
metas.description: An emotionally complex and utterly terrifying prestige horror film that will appeal to your appreciation for chilling supernatural cinema like The Exorcism of Emily Rose.

metas.name: The Menu
metas.description: A sharp, biting dark comedy thriller that presents high-stakes social satire, perfect for fans of dark comedies like In Bruges and twisty scenarios like Exam.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: A gritty, tension-filled crime drama featuring a high-stakes game of cat and mouse, highly recommended for fans of Sicario.

metas.name: The Prestige
metas.description: A beautifully constructed mystery of rivalry and obsession that challenges the viewer, matching the intellectual puzzles of Gone Girl and Exam.

metas.name: Nightcrawler
metas.description: A dark, gripping character study of a sociopathic videographer. It captures the psychological intensity and moral ambiguity found in The Master.

metas.name: Midsommar
metas.description: A brilliant, sun-drenched psychological horror movie about grief and toxic relationships, offering a deep, challenging viewing experience like Smile 2.

metas.name: Anatomy of a Fall
metas.description: A compelling, Palme d'Or-winning courtroom drama that explores truth and ambiguity, capturing the high-stakes human tension of Conclave.

metas.name: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
metas.description: A sterile, deeply unsettling psychological thriller/black comedy that fits comfortably alongside the dark humor of In Bruges and the dread of Exam.

metas.name: First Reformed
metas.description: A quiet, devastating character study of a priest undergoing a crisis of faith, mirroring the spiritual and psychological gravity of Conclave and The Master.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description: An intensely gritty, action-thriller masterpiece about survival in a dystopian future, perfect for fans of 28 Days Later.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: A mind-bending chamber-piece sci-fi thriller about a dinner party gone wrong, appealing directly to fans of Exam, It's What's Inside, and Ex Machina.

metas.name: Get Out
metas.description: An outstanding psychological horror and social satire that challenges the audience, matching the mystery elements of Smile 2.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description: A legendary anime psychological thriller that explores identity and paranoia, bridging your love for animation with dark, complex thrillers.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description: An engaging, detail-oriented drama focusing on high-stakes journalistic investigation, reflecting the prestige pacing and smart writing of Conclave.

metas.name: The Lighthouse
metas.description: A claustrophobic, intense, and bizarre descent into madness featuring powerhouse performances that match the psychological weight of The Master.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description: A devastating, beautifully directed mystery and war drama that features jaw-dropping revelations, perfect for fans of intense, prestige drama.

metas.name: Wind River
metas.description: A haunting, cold-climate crime thriller written by the creator of Sicario, sharing its gritty atmosphere and high-stakes tension.

metas.name: Grave of the Fireflies
metas.description: A devastatingly beautiful Studio Ghibli masterpiece dealing with war and tragedy, appealing to your love of high-art animation like The Wind Rises.

metas.name: Moon
metas.description: A quiet, thought-provoking science fiction drama that relies on isolation and psychological depth, matching the tone of Ex Machina.

metas.name: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
metas.description: A cold, atmospheric mystery packed with tension and brilliant investigation, appealing to fans of David Fincher's Gone Girl.

metas.name: Green Room
metas.description: An incredibly tense, visceral survival thriller that never lets up, matching the sheer kinetic panic of 28 Days Later.

metas.name: The Game
metas.description: A classic David Fincher mystery thriller that constantly leaves you questioning reality, perfect for fans of Gone Girl and Exam.

metas.name: Burning
metas.description: An atmospheric, slow-burn psychological mystery from South Korea that builds an unforgettable sense of dread and obsession.

metas.name: Margin Call
metas.description: A dialogue-driven, claustrophobic drama about a financial crisis over 24 hours. Its high intellectual stakes and stellar ensemble mirror Conclave.

metas.name: A Serious Man
metas.description: A dark, existential Coen Brothers comedy that balances bleak themes with dry absurdity, perfect for fans of In Bruges.

metas.name: Misery
metas.description: A legendary, tightly contained psychological thriller about obsession and isolation, perfect for fans of classic, character-driven tension.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: A slow-burn, atmospheric period piece horror that leans heavily on religious dread and paranoia, appealing to fans of The Others.

metas.name: Se7en
metas.description: The quintessential dark crime thriller that explores deep emotional complexity and grim themes, heavily aligning with Gone Girl.

metas.name: The Machinist
metas.description: A gritty, psychologically complex mystery about guilt and insomnia, offering a dark and highly challenging narrative.

metas.name: Gone Baby Gone
metas.description: A morally gray, gritty crime drama with a massive ethical dilemma at its core, perfect for fans of Sicario and Gone Girl.

metas.name: A Quiet Place
metas.description: A highly intense, sensory horror-thriller that demands your full attention and features high emotional stakes, matching 28 Days Later.

metas.name: Barbarian
metas.description: A highly unpredictable, twisty modern horror-thriller that constantly subverts expectations, appealing to fans of Smile 2 and It's What's Inside.

metas.name: Upgrade
metas.description: A dark, sci-fi action thriller focusing on human enhancement and AI control, matching the technology-focussed themes of Ex Machina.

metas.name: Source Code
metas.description: A fast-paced, high-concept sci-fi mystery that keeps you guessing about the reality of the situation, matching the puzzle nature of Exam.

metas.name: 10 Cloverfield Lane
metas.description: A masterful, claustrophobic chamber thriller that keeps you guessing about the truth, perfect for fans of Exam and Ex Machina.

metas.name: The Invisible Man
metas.description: An incredibly tense, modern psychological horror film focused on trauma and gaslighting, matching the dread of Smile 2.
